title: Quantitative stability of constant equilibria in a non-linear alignment model of self-propelled particles
summary: We are interested in the long-time behaviour of the kinetic Vicsek equation, rigorously derived as the mean-field limit~\cite{bolley2012meanfield} of a coupled system of~$N$ stochastic differential equations describing particles moving at unit velocity and aligning with their neighbours. We focus on the local-in-space version (that may for instance appear as a moderate interaction limit instead of mean-field), which is not a priori globally well-posed and could explode in finite time.
